_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading midstream service provider of gathering, processing, fractionation, transportation, storage and marine export services.' 'Each of our four reportable segments are primarily fee-based, and our consolidated earnings were more than 85% fee-based in 2023.' 'The volatility of natural gas, NGL, Refined Products and crude oil prices could affect adversely our earnings and cash flows.' (the FY2023 10-K's own words; it does not use the word cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty; ENERGY_TRANSITION's reserves and refining are out of scope (the TRGP and BKR reading): ONEOK holds no reserves of its own and refines nothing ('We may not be able to accurately estimate hydrocarbon reserves and production volumes expected to be delivered to us for a variety of reasons, including the unavailability of sufficiently detailed information and unanticipated changes in producers’ expected drilling schedules.'); its greenhouse gas risk factor: 'We may face significant costs to comply with the regulation of GHG emissions.' (text only); its climate risk factor: 'Increasing attention to ESG issues, including climate change, may impact our business.' (text only); EV and CRYPTO are out of scope: the 10-K names neither electric vehicles nor crypto (text only); GENAI and GLP1 are out of scope: the 10-K names no artificial intelligence and it names no GLP-1 drug (text only); the 10-K's cloud words are its own cybersecurity vendors: 'In order to manage these cybersecurity risks, including our use of third-party software and cloud vendors, we have developed and implemented a cybersecurity risk management program intended to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of our critical systems and information.' (text only)

BEAR.desc: EPS -53.7%/yr (worst year FY14-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -3.1%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.3%/yr (FY14-FY23 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +64.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2024-07-05) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.60x (84.2% downside to Bear $13 / +140.7% upside to Bull $198) | Adj composite 2.35 vs market 1.88: gap +0.47 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +29% above the EPP floor $64 (13x FY24E $4.92) | Conservative 2-yr case: +35.5% total (+17.8%/yr) | At 16.7x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $109 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net margin +60.5% and Distribution operating income n/r in Q1 2024, forward revenues +5.8% (no FY24 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2024 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (CLOUD and OFFSHORE are scoped to IT, ECOMMERCE to retail, STREAMING to TV, ENERGY_TRANSITION to reserves and refining, EV to fuel retail, CRYPTO to payments and banks, GENAI to software, services and content, GLP1 to food and devices).
